authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9871 marate compares Pali marati, Prakrit maraï, widespread mar- verbs, Bhojpuri maral and Hindi marnā. Turner leaves derivation from Vedic mar- versus remodeling from other verbal forms open. These simple stem/inflection forms are linked to this family; auxiliary-bearing and negative constructions are excluded.
